differences.what: Long front with centre pavilion, corner turrets, battlemented parapet, two tiers of windows and the stack behind north of centre stand where the print shows them
Roof: the print was taken after the fire and shows the walls standing roofless; the scene is the night before, so the slate roof is built (the fire leaves the walls)
The works' south half stands behind the tower in the print and cannot be compared from it
The pavilion's pinnacles and the corbel table under the parapet are drawn simpler than the print

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
